guidanceFallbackDecision.why: A guidance fallback has to be built out of something. The pinned corpus contains no Colorado juvenile material of any kind — no JDF 302, no juvenile instruction sheet, no statutory extract — so the only place the filing destination, the fee treatment, the service rule and the hearing stops could come from is the model's own recollection. AGENTS.md forbids exactly that: fee, copy and service notes may be used only where the source packet or official form states them, and clerk addresses, agency addresses, local fees and service rules may not be invented. A guidance packet assembled that way would carry a participant to a courthouse on unsourced instructions, which is worse than telling the captain the source is missing.
guidanceFallbackDecision.whatWouldUnblockIt: Add the Colorado juvenile materials to the pinned corpus — at minimum JDF 302 and its instruction sheet. With a sourced filing design in hand this route can take the same route the two petition routes take.
guidanceFallbackDecision.notASubstituteForPacketWork: This is not a half-built packet relabelled. No juvenile packet work exists to disguise: there is no overlay family, no field census and no fixture for any Colorado juvenile form, because there is no form.
